metadata.title: Micron Stock Is in a Slump. The Case for It Soaring 140%.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
The Case for Micron Stock Leaping 140%
Micron Technology stock has fallen well below its recent highs. But the memory-chip maker can more than recoup its recent losses, according to KeyBanc analyst John Vinh.
